paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates training and validation loss values across training epochs, with two lines labeled “Train” and “Validation.” The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 0 to 30 with regularly spaced tick labels every 5 epochs (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30). The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, spanning about 0.5 to 2.25 with evenly spaced tick labels at 0.25 intervals (e.g., 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, …, 2.25). The Train series is a solid blue line with no markers that decreases steadily across the epoch range, starting near 1.8 at epoch 0 and ending near 0.5 by the final epochs (around epoch 29), with a smooth downward progression (e.g., near ~1.1 by around epoch 4–5, ~0.9 by around epoch 10, and ~0.6 by around epoch 22). The Validation series is a solid green line with no markers that fluctuates in the early and middle epochs before trending downward later; it starts near 1.7 at epoch 0, varies around roughly 1.4–1.8 through the first ~10 epochs, reaches a visible peak near 2.2 around epoch 11, then drops and continues with smaller fluctuations while generally declining (e.g., around ~1.7 near epoch 13, ~1.4–1.5 around epochs 16–18, about ~1.35 around epoch 20, and around ~1.0 by the last several epochs), ending just under 1.0 near the final epoch.
